listeners.doc: TCP listener bound to one port. Dispatches each new connection to the attached service's onConnect handler.

serviceTypes.doc: Handles a new TCP connection. Its onConnect handler decides whether to accept the connection and, if so, returns the connection service that will process its bytes.

options.name: onConnect
options.doc: Invoked once a new client connects. Returns the connection service instance that will handle this connection's bytes, or an error to reject the connection.

params.name: caller
params.doc: Handle for the newly connected client, exposing its remote/local host and port. Store it if the returned connection service needs to write back later.

serviceTypes.doc: The per-connection service returned by onConnect. Its handlers are invoked over the lifetime of one TCP connection.

options.name: onBytes
options.doc: Invoked once for each chunk of bytes received from the client. Return bytes to write back to the same client, or () to send nothing.

params.name: data
params.doc: The bytes received from the client.

options.name: onError
options.doc: Invoked when the connection fails, such as a read or write error on the underlying socket.

params.name: err
params.doc: The failure that occurred on this connection.

options.name: onClose
options.doc: Invoked when the connection is closed, by either side.
